correctness.rationale: Direct substitution gives the nonzero ordinary Jacobiator \(J(e_1,e_1,e_4)=2e_4\) and shows the printed map fails multiplicativity on \(e_1^2=e_2\) for every parameter choice. Solving the algebra-endomorphism equations yields exactly the two stated branches. For an endomorphism, the twisted Hom-Jacobian is \(lpha^2\) applied to the ordinary Jacobiator, so validity is exactly \(lpha^2(e_4)=0\). The finite-field formulas are direct parameter counts and the checker exhaustively reconstructs all endomorphisms over \(\mathbf F_3\).

value.rationale: Example 3.4 is the paper's first explicit four-dimensional twisting construction and is reproduced in the later journal version, so repairing it has direct reference value. The result goes beyond a cheap counterexample: it gives the complete endomorphism space of the printed algebra, exactly characterizes which endomorphisms still yield genuine multiplicative Hom-Jacobi–Jordan structures, proves that no automorphism can do so, and supplies uniform finite-field and zeta formulas.
